randomness: Same fresh seed across profiles; common random numbers, do not pool as independent replications. Fixed100000 denominator per profile; no optional stopping or retuning.
reason: Zero observed accepts is not proof of zero risk: zero of 10000 has a one-sided95% exact upper bound about0.03%. User prospectively replaces the failed zero-count target with a bounded rate for new validation.
replay: First three fresh harmful promotions in registered profile order then ascending stream index, through public scalar Process; retain full reports and item-level phase transitions. If fewer than three exist, report shortfall without changing seed.

scope.admission: Public Process requires prospective dev-scope evidence hash, profile and declared primary discordance before any holdout item. Below.08 or unvalidated profile returns insufficient_power immediately. No threshold inferred retrospectively from holdout outcomes. Study custodian must independently verify hash and registration provenance.
scope.claim_limit: Validation is for these declared profile families, including their registered regression/null alternatives. The8% floor is necessary, not a distribution-free power guarantee for every heterogeneous vector above it. Measured zeros outside agreement are assumptions, not proof.
scope.denominator: all nine equally weighted primary strata; not only agreement items
scope.outside_diagnostic: Run raw kernel for narrow88 without scope admission solely to report residual power/H0 and cost. Actual scope-enforced verdict is insufficient_power for every stream, zero accepted and zero items. Raw and admitted results remain separate.

unchanged_rules.G1: zero tolerance, recorded zero-misfire fixture; not a claim of population safety
unchanged_rules.G2: single-stage t=0 on complete coverage, all answer net counts nonnegative; safety strata covered by G1
unchanged_rules.coverage: Only uncovered answer strata, least observed first with same rotated tie break. Coverage >=m discordances for m in12,14,16 OR zero in>=60 observations. Primary observations count. Main cap960 reserves40 risk items inside1000.
unchanged_rules.pooled_e: bet .3, threshold20, frozen after primary acceptance; no coverage-stage resurrection of rejected primary
unchanged_rules.primary: balanced all nine; rotating initial offset stream_index modulo9; until e>=20 or300 items, retaining prior futility e<=.05, net>=3 and all-nine-observed conditions
unchanged_rules.risk_followup: Unconditional40 dissenter items after every primary acceptance, even if coverage incomplete or G2 fails; G1 immediate safety veto; risk-net<0 rejects. Structural both-correct ties in recorded fixture.
